hash must point to the message hash; hash_len specifies its byte length.
pk must be a valid EC public key for the curve.
sig must point to the raw signature buffer; sig_len is its length.
Caller must check the return value; 0 indicates verification failure.

functions.name: br_ecdsa_sign_asn1_get_default
functions.description: Return the preferred ECDSA signing function (ASN.1 output) for the current system. Use the returned function pointer to perform ECDSA signing in ASN.1 format.
requirements: Caller should check the returned function pointer is non-NULL before use.

functions.name: br_ecdsa_sign_raw_get_default
functions.description: Return the preferred ECDSA signing function (raw output) for the current system. Use the returned function pointer to perform ECDSA signing in raw r||s format.
requirements: Caller should check the returned function pointer is non-NULL before use.

functions.name: br_ecdsa_vrfy_asn1_get_default
functions.description: Return the preferred ECDSA verification function (ASN.1 input) for the current system. Use the returned function pointer to verify ASN.1-encoded signatures.
requirements: Caller should check the returned function pointer is non-NULL before use.

functions.name: br_ecdsa_vrfy_raw_get_default
functions.description: Return the preferred ECDSA verification function (raw input) for the current system. Use the returned function pointer to verify raw r||s signatures.
requirements: Caller should check the returned function pointer is non-NULL before use.

functions.name: br_ec_keygen
functions.signature: size_t br_ec_keygen(const br_prng_class **rng_ctx, const br_ec_impl *impl, br_ec_private_key *sk, void *kbuf, int curve);
functions.description: Generate a new EC private key for the given curve using the provided PRNG and EC implementation. Writes the private key into kbuf and sets sk fields to reference it. Returns the key data length (bytes) or 0 if the curve is unsupported. If kbuf is NULL, no key is generated; the required length is still returned.
requirements: rng_ctx must point to an already-initialized PRNG context.
impl must be a valid EC implementation; if it does not support the specified curve, the function returns 0.
curve must be a supported named-curve identifier (e.g., BR_EC_secp256r1).
kbuf, when non-NULL, must point to a writable buffer large enough for the private key. The maximum required size across supported curves is BR_EC_KBUF_PRIV_MAX_SIZE (72 bytes).
If kbuf is NULL, sk may be NULL; the function then only reports the required length.
If sk is NULL but kbuf is non-NULL, the key is still generated into kbuf.
On success, sk->x will point into kbuf; ensure kbuf outlives sk usage.
Caller must check the return value; 0 indicates failure/unsupported curve.

functions.name: br_ec_compute_pub
functions.signature: size_t br_ec_compute_pub(const br_ec_impl *impl, br_ec_public_key *pk, void *kbuf, const br_ec_private_key *sk);
functions.description: Compute the EC public key point from an EC private key using the provided EC implementation. Writes the uncompressed public point into kbuf and, if pk is non-NULL, sets pk to reference it. Returns the public point length (bytes) or 0 if the curve is unsupported. If kbuf is NULL, no computation is done; the required length is still returned.
requirements: impl must support the curve designated by sk->curve; otherwise the function returns 0.
sk must contain a valid private key for the curve. Off-range private values may not be detected and lead to unpredictable results.
kbuf, when non-NULL, must be a writable buffer large enough to hold the encoded uncompressed public point. The maximum required size across supported curves is BR_EC_KBUF_PUB_MAX_SIZE (145 bytes).
If kbuf is NULL, pk may be NULL; the function still returns the required buffer size.
If pk is NULL but kbuf is non-NULL, the point is computed into kbuf and its size is returned.
On success, if pk is non-NULL, pk->q will point into kbuf; ensure kbuf outlives pk usage.
Caller must check the return value; 0 indicates failure/unsupported curve.

functions.name: br_rsa_i32_public
functions.signature: uint32_t br_rsa_i32_public(unsigned char *x, size_t xlen, const br_rsa_public_key *pk);
functions.description: Performs RSA public-key modular exponentiation (encrypt/verify primitive) using the i32 backend. Operates in place on x and returns 1 on success, 0 on error (e.g., length mismatch or invalid/oversized operand).
requirements: x must be the same byte length as the modulus (exact mathematical length).
The integer value in x must be < modulus.
pk must reference a valid RSA public key with an odd, non-zero modulus.
On error, x contents become unspecified.

functions.name: br_rsa_i32_pkcs1_vrfy
functions.signature: uint32_t br_rsa_i32_pkcs1_vrfy(const unsigned char *x, size_t xlen, const unsigned char *hash_oid, size_t hash_len, const br_rsa_public_key *pk, unsigned char *hash_out);
functions.description: Verifies a PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA signature with the i32 backend. Extracts the encoded digest from the signature into hash_out; caller must compare it to the expected message hash.
requirements: xlen must equal the modulus length (exact).
hash_len must be ≤ 64 bytes.
If hash_oid is not NULL, hash_oid[0] (OID length) must be in 0..32 and the buffer must contain 1+that many bytes.
pk must be a valid RSA public key and modulus must not exceed the implementation’s maximum.
Returned 1 means the padding/format was valid and hash was extracted; caller must compare with expected hash.
x is not modified.

functions.name: br_rsa_i32_pss_vrfy
functions.signature: uint32_t br_rsa_i32_pss_vrfy(const unsigned char *x, size_t xlen, const br_hash_class *hf_data, const br_hash_class *hf_mgf1, const void *hash, size_t salt_len, const br_rsa_public_key *pk);
functions.description: Verifies an RSA-PSS signature with the i32 backend using the provided hash implementations (hf_data for the message hash, hf_mgf1 for MGF1) and the given hashed message.
requirements: xlen must equal the modulus length (exact).
The provided message hash length must be ≤ 64 bytes (size implied by hf_data/hash).
hf_data and hf_mgf1 must point to valid hash-class implementations.
hash must point to the hashed message; its size must match hf_data output size.
salt_len is the salt size used by the signature.
pk must be a valid RSA public key and modulus within the supported maximum.
x is not modified.

functions.name: br_rsa_i32_private
functions.description: Performs RSA private-key operation (CRT-based) using the i32 backend. Operates in place on x with length inferred from sk->n_bitlen.
requirements: x must be a buffer of exactly (sk->n_bitlen+7)/8 bytes.
sk must be a valid RSA private key (with p, q, dp, dq, iq filled) and n_bitlen exact.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error; on error x becomes unspecified.

functions.name: br_rsa_i32_pkcs1_sign
functions.signature: uint32_t br_rsa_i32_pkcs1_sign(const unsigned char *hash_oid, const unsigned char *hash, size_t hash_len, const br_rsa_private_key *sk, unsigned char *x);
functions.description: Generates a PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA signature with the i32 backend. Encodes digest info (with ASN.1 NULL) if hash_oid is provided; otherwise uses the raw hash. Signature is written to x.
requirements: hash_len must be appropriate for the hash used; the modulus must be large enough for the encoding.
If hash_oid is not NULL, it must point to an encoded OID byte string beginning with its length byte, length ≤ 32.
sk must be valid; signature length is exactly (sk->n_bitlen+7)/8 bytes.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: br_rsa_i32_pss_sign

Returns 0 on error or on internal limit exceedance.

functions.name: br_rsa_compute_privexp_get_default
functions.description: Returns the preferred (default) implementation for recomputing the private exponent from a private key and public exponent.
requirements: Caller must check the returned pointer is non-NULL before use.

functions.name: br_gcm_init
functions.signature: void br_gcm_init(br_gcm_context *ctx, const br_block_ctr_class **bctx, br_ghash gh)
functions.description: Initialize a GCM AEAD context with a pre-initialized 16-byte-block CTR-mode block cipher context and a GHASH implementation. After initialization, call br_gcm_reset() to start a computation with a nonce.
requirements: ctx must point to writable br_gcm_context storage.

bctx must reference a block cipher implementation in CTR mode with 16-byte blocks, already initialized with the secret key; the lifetime of the referenced cipher context must outlive the GCM operations.
gh must be a valid GHASH implementation pointer.
Caller must invoke br_gcm_reset() with a nonce before injecting AAD or running encryption/decryption.

functions.name: br_gcm_reset
functions.signature: void br_gcm_reset(br_gcm_context *ctx, const void *iv, size_t len)
functions.description: Reset an initialized GCM context for a new AEAD run and set the nonce (IV). Cancels any ongoing computation in the context.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_gcm_init().
iv points to the nonce; len is its length in bytes (can be any length; 12 bytes is the recommended length).
For security, the (key, nonce) pair must never be reused.
May be called at any time to start a new computation; it cancels any ongoing run.

functions.name: br_gcm_aad_inject
functions.signature: void br_gcm_aad_inject(br_gcm_context *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Inject additional authenticated data (AAD) into a running GCM computation. May be called multiple times before br_gcm_flip().
requirements: ctx must have been reset with br_gcm_reset() for the current run.
Must be called only before br_gcm_flip().
data points to AAD; len is its length in bytes. May be called with arbitrary chunk sizes.
Total AAD length must not exceed the algorithm limit (up to 2^64−1 bits per GCM specification).

functions.name: br_gcm_flip
functions.description: Finalize AAD injection and transition the GCM context to data processing. Must be called before br_gcm_run(), even if no AAD was provided.
requirements: ctx must refer to a GCM context reset for the current run.
Must be called exactly once per run after finishing AAD injection and before any br_gcm_run() calls.
After this call, no further AAD may be injected.

functions.name: br_gcm_run
functions.signature: void br_gcm_run(br_gcm_context *ctx, int encrypt, void *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Encrypt or decrypt data in place under GCM after br_gcm_flip(). If encrypt != 0, plaintext is encrypted; otherwise ciphertext is decrypted.
requirements: ctx must have been flipped with br_gcm_flip() for the current run.
data must point to a buffer of at least len bytes and is modified in place.
May be called multiple times; chunk sizes are arbitrary.
Total processed data length over the run must not exceed 2^39−256 bits (~65 GiB).
encrypt must be non-zero for encryption and zero for decryption.

functions.name: br_gcm_get_tag
functions.description: Compute the 16-byte GCM authentication tag and write it to tag. Terminates the current GCM run; further processing requires br_gcm_reset().
requirements: All AAD and message data for the run must have been injected/processed before calling.
tag must point to a writable buffer of at least 16 bytes.
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_gcm_check_tag
functions.description: Compute the GCM tag and compare it to the provided 16-byte tag. Returns 1 on exact match, 0 on mismatch. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and message data for the run must have been injected/processed before calling.
tag must point to a buffer containing a 16-byte tag to verify.
Caller must check the return value and reject the message on 0 (mismatch).
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_gcm_get_tag_trunc
functions.description: Compute a (possibly truncated) GCM authentication tag of length len and write it to tag. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and message data must have been processed before calling.
len must be 16 bytes or less per API; using shorter tags weakens integrity (see NIST SP 800-38D guidance).
tag must point to a writable buffer of at least len bytes.
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_gcm_check_tag_trunc
functions.signature: uint32_t br_gcm_check_tag_trunc(br_gcm_context *ctx, const void *tag, size_t len)
functions.description: Compute the GCM tag and compare it to the provided tag of length len. Returns 1 on exact match, 0 otherwise. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and message data must have been processed before calling.
len must be 16 bytes or less.
tag must point to a buffer containing a tag of length len bytes.
Caller must check the return value and reject the message on 0 (mismatch).
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_eax_init
functions.description: Initialize an EAX AEAD context with a pre-initialized 16-byte-block CTR+CBC-MAC block cipher context. After initialization, call br_eax_reset() (or one of the reset variants) to start a computation with a nonce.
requirements: ctx must point to writable br_eax_context storage.
bctx must reference a CTR+CBC-MAC block cipher implementation with 16-byte blocks, already initialized with the secret key; its lifetime must cover the EAX operations.
Caller must invoke an appropriate reset function before injecting AAD or running encryption/decryption.

functions.name: br_eax_capture
functions.description: Precompute and capture key-dependent state from an EAX context into st for reuse across messages to reduce per-message overhead. Does not modify ctx.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_eax_init().
st must point to writable br_eax_state storage.
Captured state is intended for use with br_eax_reset_pre_aad() or, after updating with br_eax_get_aad_mac(), with br_eax_reset_post_aad().

functions.name: br_eax_reset
functions.signature: void br_eax_reset(br_eax_context *ctx, const void *nonce, size_t len)
functions.description: Reset an initialized EAX context for a new AEAD run and set the nonce. Cancels any ongoing computation in the context.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_eax_init().
nonce points to the nonce; len is its length in bytes (arbitrary length allowed).
For security, do not reuse a (key, nonce) pair. If nonces are random, 16-byte nonces are recommended to keep collision probability negligible.

functions.name: br_eax_reset_pre_aad
functions.signature: void br_eax_reset_pre_aad(br_eax_context *ctx, const br_eax_state *st, const void *nonce, size_t len)
functions.description: Reset an EAX context using a pre-AAD captured state to reduce per-message overhead. After this call, AAD must be injected before flipping; empty AAD or empty message is not supported in this mode.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_eax_init().
st must be a state previously captured with br_eax_capture() and not updated with br_eax_get_aad_mac().
nonce points to the nonce; len is its length in bytes; (key, nonce) pairs must not be reused.
After this call, caller MUST inject at least one byte of AAD via br_eax_aad_inject() before calling br_eax_flip().
After br_eax_flip(), caller MUST provide at least one byte of message data via br_eax_run(); empty messages are not supported with this reset mode.

functions.name: br_eax_reset_post_aad
functions.signature: void br_eax_reset_post_aad(br_eax_context *ctx, const br_eax_state *st, const void *nonce, size_t len)
functions.description: Reset an EAX context using a post-AAD captured state (i.e., state captured then updated with br_eax_get_aad_mac()). After this call, message data must be injected directly; do not call br_eax_flip(); empty messages are not supported in this mode.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_eax_init().
st must be a state captured with br_eax_capture() and then updated with br_eax_get_aad_mac().
nonce points to the nonce; len is its length in bytes; (key, nonce) pairs must not be reused.
After this call, message data MUST be provided via br_eax_run(); do not call br_eax_flip().
Caller MUST provide at least one byte of message data; empty messages are not supported with this reset mode.

functions.name: br_eax_aad_inject
functions.signature: void br_eax_aad_inject(br_eax_context *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Inject additional authenticated data (AAD) into a running EAX computation. May be called multiple times before br_eax_flip().
requirements: ctx must have been reset for the current run (via br_eax_reset() or br_eax_reset_pre_aad()).
Must be called only before br_eax_flip().
data points to AAD; len is its length in bytes. May be called with arbitrary chunk sizes.
Total AAD length is unlimited per EAX specification.

functions.name: br_eax_flip
functions.description: Finalize AAD injection and transition the EAX context to data processing. Must be called before br_eax_run(), even if no AAD was provided (except when using post-AAD reset mode, where flip must not be called).
requirements: For normal or pre-AAD reset modes, must be called exactly once per run after finishing AAD injection and before any br_eax_run() calls.
After this call, no further AAD may be injected.
Must NOT be called when the context was reset with br_eax_reset_post_aad().

functions.name: br_eax_run
functions.signature: void br_eax_run(br_eax_context *ctx, int encrypt, void *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Encrypt or decrypt data in place under EAX after the appropriate transition. If encrypt != 0, plaintext is encrypted; otherwise ciphertext is decrypted.
requirements: For normal and pre-AAD reset modes, ctx must have been flipped with br_eax_flip(). For post-AAD reset mode, br_eax_flip() must not be called and data must be injected directly.
data must point to a buffer of at least len bytes and is modified in place.
May be called multiple times; chunk sizes are arbitrary.
encrypt must be non-zero for encryption and zero for decryption.

functions.name: br_eax_get_tag
functions.description: Compute the 16-byte EAX authentication tag and write it to tag. Terminates the current EAX run; further processing requires a reset.
requirements: All AAD and message data for the run must have been injected/processed before calling.
tag must point to a writable buffer of at least 16 bytes.
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_eax_check_tag
functions.description: Compute the EAX tag and compare it to the provided 16-byte tag. Returns 1 on exact match, 0 on mismatch. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and message data for the run must have been injected/processed before calling.
tag must point to a buffer containing a 16-byte tag to verify.
Caller must check the return value and reject the message on 0 (mismatch).
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_eax_get_tag_trunc
functions.description: Compute a (possibly truncated) EAX authentication tag of length len and write it to tag. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and message data must have been processed before calling.
len must be 16 bytes or less per API; shorter tags weaken integrity (see guidance in the header).
tag must point to a writable buffer of at least len bytes.
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_eax_check_tag_trunc
functions.signature: uint32_t br_eax_check_tag_trunc(br_eax_context *ctx, const void *tag, size_t len)
functions.description: Compute the EAX tag and compare it to the provided tag of length len. Returns 1 on exact match, 0 otherwise. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and message data must have been processed before calling.
len must be 16 bytes or less.
tag must point to a buffer containing a tag of length len bytes.
Caller must check the return value and reject the message on 0 (mismatch).
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_ccm_init
functions.description: Initialize a CCM AEAD context with a pre-initialized 16-byte-block CTR+CBC-MAC block cipher context. After initialization, call br_ccm_reset() to configure nonce, lengths, and tag size for a run.
requirements: ctx must point to writable br_ccm_context storage.
bctx must reference a CTR+CBC-MAC block cipher implementation with 16-byte blocks, already initialized with the secret key; its lifetime must cover the CCM operations.
Caller must invoke br_ccm_reset() before injecting AAD or running encryption/decryption.

functions.name: br_ccm_reset
functions.signature: int br_ccm_reset(br_ccm_context *ctx, const void *nonce, size_t nonce_len, uint64_t aad_len, uint64_t data_len, size_t tag_len)
functions.description: Reset an initialized CCM context for a new AEAD run. Configures nonce, total AAD length, total data length, and tag length. Returns 1 on success, 0 on parameter error.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_ccm_init().
nonce points to the nonce; nonce_len must be between 7 and 13 bytes inclusive.
data_len must be strictly less than 2^(8*(15 − nonce_len)).
aad_len must exactly equal the total number of AAD bytes that will be injected for this run (may be zero).
tag_len must be an even integer between 4 and 16 bytes inclusive.
(key, nonce) pairs must not be reused; random nonces are generally not recommended due to the small nonce space.
Caller must check the return value and must not proceed with the run if 0 is returned.

functions.name: br_ccm_aad_inject
functions.signature: void br_ccm_aad_inject(br_ccm_context *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Inject additional authenticated data (AAD) into a running CCM computation. May be called multiple times before br_ccm_flip().
requirements: ctx must have been reset with br_ccm_reset() for the current run.
Must be called only before br_ccm_flip().
data points to AAD; len is its length in bytes. May be called with arbitrary chunk sizes.
Total injected AAD length across calls MUST exactly match the aad_len provided to br_ccm_reset().

functions.name: br_ccm_flip
functions.description: Finalize AAD injection and transition the CCM context to data processing. Must be called before br_ccm_run(), even if no AAD was provided.
requirements: ctx must refer to a CCM context reset for the current run.
Must be called exactly once per run after finishing AAD injection and before any br_ccm_run() calls.
After this call, no further AAD may be injected.

functions.name: br_ccm_run
functions.signature: void br_ccm_run(br_ccm_context *ctx, int encrypt, void *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Encrypt or decrypt data in place under CCM after br_ccm_flip(). If encrypt != 0, plaintext is encrypted; otherwise ciphertext is decrypted.
requirements: ctx must have been flipped with br_ccm_flip() for the current run.
data must point to a buffer of at least len bytes and is modified in place.
May be called multiple times; chunk sizes are arbitrary.
Total processed data length across all calls MUST exactly match data_len provided to br_ccm_reset().
encrypt must be non-zero for encryption and zero for decryption.

functions.name: br_ccm_get_tag
functions.description: Compute the CCM authentication tag and write it to tag. Returns the tag length (as configured in br_ccm_reset()). Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and the exact total message data (matching data_len) must have been processed before calling.
tag must point to a writable buffer large enough for the configured tag length (up to 16 bytes).
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_ccm_check_tag
functions.description: Compute the CCM tag and compare it to the provided tag (up to 16 bytes as configured). Returns 1 on exact match, 0 on mismatch. Terminates the current run.
requirements: All AAD and the exact total message data (matching data_len) must have been processed before calling.
tag must point to a buffer containing a tag of the configured length (up to 16 bytes).
Caller must check the return value and reject the message on 0 (mismatch).
After this call, the context cannot process more data until reset.

functions.name: br_aes_big_cbcenc_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_big) CBC-encryption context by expanding the provided key and setting ctx->vtable. Use before br_aes_big_cbcenc_run to encrypt blocks in CBC mode.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, writable br_aes_big_cbcenc_keys pointer.
key must point to a key of length allowed by AES (16, 24, or 32 bytes).
len must match the actual key length in bytes.
Function does not report invalid key sizes; invalid lengths may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_big_cbcdec_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_big) CBC-decryption context by expanding the key and setting ctx->vtable. Use before br_aes_big_cbcdec_run to decrypt CBC blocks.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, writable br_aes_big_cbcdec_keys pointer.
key must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes for AES.
len must equal the key length.
No key length validation is guaranteed; invalid sizes may yield undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctr_init
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_ctr_init(br_aes_big_ctr_keys *ctx, const void *key, size_t len);
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_big) CTR context for encryption/decryption by expanding the key and setting ctx->vtable. Use with br_aes_big_ctr_run.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, writable br_aes_big_ctr_keys pointer.
key length must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes; len must match.
No error is reported for invalid key lengths; invalid sizes may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctrcbc_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_big) combined CTR/CBC-MAC context (for CCM/EAX-like modes), computing subkeys and setting ctx->vtable. Use with the ctrcbc encrypt/decrypt/ctr/mac calls.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, writable br_aes_big_ctrcbc_keys pointer.
key must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes; len must match.
No key size validation is ensured; invalid lengths may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_big_cbcenc_run
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_cbcenc_run(const br_aes_big_cbcenc_keys *ctx, void *iv, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Encrypt data in-place using AES (aes_big) in CBC mode. iv is updated to the last ciphertext block. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_cbcenc_init.
iv must point to a 16-byte buffer (AES block size) and is updated in place.
data must point to a writable buffer of length len.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.
No padding is performed; caller must manage padding if needed.

functions.name: br_aes_big_cbcdec_run
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_cbcdec_run(const br_aes_big_cbcdec_keys *ctx, void *iv, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Decrypt data in-place using AES (aes_big) in CBC mode. iv is updated to the last encrypted block. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_cbcdec_init.
iv must point to a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
data must point to a writable buffer of length len.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.
No padding removal is performed; caller must handle padding.

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctr_run
functions.signature: uint32_t br_aes_big_ctr_run(const br_aes_big_ctr_keys *ctx, const void *iv, uint32_t cc, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Encrypt/decrypt data in-place using AES (aes_big) in CTR mode with NIST SP800-38A standard incrementing function. iv is 12 bytes; cc is the initial 32-bit counter; returns the updated counter value.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_ctr_init.
iv must point to exactly 12 bytes (block size − 4 for AES).
data must point to a writable buffer of length len; len can be any size (not necessarily a multiple of 16).
For chunked processing, each non-final chunk should be a multiple of the block size to preserve counter alignment (as noted).

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctrcbc_encrypt
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_ctrcbc_encrypt(const br_aes_big_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *ctr, void *cbcmac, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Perform AES (aes_big) CTR encryption in-place while computing CBC-MAC over the encrypted data. ctr is a full 16-byte counter updated by the call; cbcmac holds the CBC-MAC IV and is overwritten with the resulting MAC. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_ctrcbc_init.
ctr must point to a 16-byte counter buffer; it is updated.
cbcmac must point to a 16-byte buffer (CBC-MAC IV) and will be overwritten with the MAC.
data must point to a writable buffer.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctrcbc_decrypt
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_ctrcbc_decrypt(const br_aes_big_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *ctr, void *cbcmac, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Perform AES (aes_big) CTR decryption in-place while computing CBC-MAC over the ciphertext (pre-decryption). ctr is a 16-byte counter updated by the call; cbcmac is the CBC-MAC IV and is overwritten with the MAC. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_ctrcbc_init.
ctr must be a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
cbcmac must be a 16-byte buffer (CBC-MAC IV) and is overwritten with the MAC.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctrcbc_ctr
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_ctrcbc_ctr(const br_aes_big_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *ctr, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Apply AES (aes_big) CTR encryption/decryption in-place using a full 16-byte counter. ctr is updated. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_ctrcbc_init.
ctr must point to a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_big_ctrcbc_mac
functions.signature: void br_aes_big_ctrcbc_mac(const br_aes_big_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *cbcmac, const void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Compute CBC-MAC using AES (aes_big) over the provided data without modifying it. cbcmac is both the IV input and the output buffer for the resulting MAC. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_big_ctrcbc_init.
cbcmac must point to a 16-byte buffer (CBC-MAC IV) and will be overwritten with the MAC.
data must be readable for len bytes.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_small_cbcenc_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_small) CBC-encryption context. Use before br_aes_small_cbcenc_run.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, writable br_aes_small_cbcenc_keys pointer.
key length must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes; len must match.
No validation is guaranteed for invalid lengths; misuse may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_small_cbcdec_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_small) CBC-decryption context. Use before br_aes_small_cbcdec_run.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, writable br_aes_small_cbcdec_keys pointer.
key must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes; len must match.
Invalid lengths are not reported and may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctr_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_small) CTR context for encryption/decryption. Use with br_aes_small_ctr_run.
requirements: ctx must be valid and writable.
key length must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes; len must match.
No error reporting for invalid key lengths; invalid values may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctrcbc_init
functions.description: Initialize AES (aes_small) combined CTR/CBC-MAC context. Use with aes_small ctrcbc functions.
requirements: ctx must be valid and writable.
key length must be 16, 24, or 32 bytes; len must match.
Invalid key sizes not reported and may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: br_aes_small_cbcenc_run
functions.signature: void br_aes_small_cbcenc_run(const br_aes_small_cbcenc_keys *ctx, void *iv, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Encrypt data in-place with AES (aes_small) in CBC mode. iv updated. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_small_cbcenc_init.
iv must be a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_small_cbcdec_run
functions.signature: void br_aes_small_cbcdec_run(const br_aes_small_cbcdec_keys *ctx, void *iv, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Decrypt data in-place with AES (aes_small) in CBC mode. iv updated. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_small_cbcdec_init.
iv must be a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctr_run
functions.signature: uint32_t br_aes_small_ctr_run(const br_aes_small_ctr_keys *ctx, const void *iv, uint32_t cc, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Encrypt/decrypt data in-place using AES (aes_small) in CTR mode with 12-byte IV and 32-bit counter starting at cc. Returns updated counter.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_small_ctr_init.
iv must be exactly 12 bytes.
data must be writable for len bytes; len can be any size.
For chunked processing, each non-final chunk should be a multiple of 16 (noted for alignment).

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctrcbc_encrypt
functions.signature: void br_aes_small_ctrcbc_encrypt(const br_aes_small_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *ctr, void *cbcmac, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Perform AES (aes_small) CTR encryption with concurrent CBC-MAC over the encrypted data. ctr (16 bytes) and cbcmac (16 bytes) are updated; len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_small_ctrcbc_init.
ctr must be a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
cbcmac must be a 16-byte buffer; overwritten with the resulting MAC.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctrcbc_decrypt
functions.signature: void br_aes_small_ctrcbc_decrypt(const br_aes_small_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *ctr, void *cbcmac, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Perform AES (aes_small) CTR decryption with concurrent CBC-MAC over the ciphertext. ctr and cbcmac are 16-byte buffers and updated. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_small_ctrcbc_init.
ctr must be a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
cbcmac must be a 16-byte buffer; overwritten with resulting MAC.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctrcbc_ctr
functions.signature: void br_aes_small_ctrcbc_ctr(const br_aes_small_ctrcbc_keys *ctx, void *ctr, void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Apply AES (aes_small) CTR in-place using a full 16-byte counter. ctr is updated. len must be a multiple of 16.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with br_aes_small_ctrcbc_init.
ctr must be a 16-byte buffer and is updated.
data must be writable.
len must be a multiple of 16 bytes.

functions.name: br_aes_small_ctrcbc_mac
